title: Nanoporous boron-doped diamond-like carbon (DLC) electrodes for electrocatalytic nitrate reduction
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2026, 10,667-674
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE01507C, Paper
Xiangfeng Zhang, Shengli Zhu, Zhenduo Cui, Zhaoyang Li, Wence Xu, Zhonghui Gao, Yanqin Liang, Hui Jiang
A boron-doped DLC electrode was fabricated via the “laser-direct-writing” strategy for nitrate reduction. The B0.57DG electrode achieved a high NH3 faradaic efficiency of 80% and an ammonia yield rate of 550 µg cm−2 h−1 at −0.59 V vs. RHE.
